name: indykite-skills
description: IndyKite skills for coding agents — Agent Gateway deployment, MCP server calls, KBAC authorization policies, and ContX IQ policies / Knowledge Queries / executes (read, create node, create relationship, combined create-with-link, add property, add relationship property, delete).

API_URL.title: API URL
API_URL.description: IndyKite REST API base URL for the project's region (e.g. https://us.api.indykite.com or https://eu.api.indykite.com).

API_KEY.title: AppAgent token (X-IK-ClientKey)
API_KEY.description: AppAgent credentials token. Goes into the X-IK-ClientKey header on every CIQ / MCP call. Mint via POST /configs/v1/application-agent-credentials.

BEARER_TOKEN.title: User OAuth token (Authorization Bearer)
BEARER_TOKEN.description: User OAuth access token. Required for Person-subject CIQ flows and for MCP session initialisation; omit for _Application-subject flows.

SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.title: Service Account token
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.description: Token with Config API write access. Used to create CIQ policies and Knowledge Queries (POST /configs/v1/authorization-policies and POST /configs/v1/knowledge-queries). Not required to execute existing Knowledge Queries.

MCP_URL.title: MCP server URL
MCP_URL.description: IndyKite MCP server base URL for the project's region (e.g. https://us.mcp.indykite.com or https://eu.mcp.indykite.com). Required only when using the indykite-mcp-server skill.

PROJECT_GID.title: Project GID
PROJECT_GID.description: IndyKite project identifier. Visible in the Hub UI on the project settings page; required by indykite-mcp-server for the URL path.
